exports.name: DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_LIMIT
exports.summary: Constant/variable `DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_LIMIT` defining default notification limit in `src/common/notifications`.
exports.summaryZh: 常量/变量 `DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_LIMIT`，定义 `src/common/notifications` 中的默认通知限制。

exports.name: NotificationCountComponent
exports.summary:
Small badge overlay (typically on an icon/avatar) showing a notification count or a plain
dot indicator, positioned via `positionX`/`positionY`.
exports.summaryZh:
小型徽标覆层（通常叠加在图标/头像上），显示通知数量或纯圆点提示，
通过 `positionX`/`positionY` 控制位置。

inputs.name: color
inputs.description:
color?: "primary" | "accent" | "warn"
Sets the theme color of the notification tip. Defaults to "warn"
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入属性 `color`（类型：`'primary' | 'accent' | 'warn'`），用于配置颜色（默认值：`'warn'`）。

inputs.name: positionX
inputs.description:
positionX?: NotificationCountPositionX or "before" | "after" | "center"
Sets the X position of the notification tip.
Defaults to "after" if it has content, else 'center'.
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入属性 `positionX` 的设置器，用于更新位置X坐标。

inputs.name: positionY
inputs.description:
positionY?: NotificationCountPositionY or "top" | "bottom" | "center"
Sets the Y position of the notification tip.
Defaults to "top" if it has content, else 'center'.
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入属性 `positionY` 的设置器，用于更新位置Y坐标。

inputs.name: notifications
inputs.description:
notifications?: number | boolean
Number for the notification count. Shows component only if the input is a positive number or 'true'
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入属性 `notifications` 的设置器，用于更新通知。

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description:
limit?: number
Limit for notification count. If the number of notifications is greater than limit, then + will be added. Defaults to 99.
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入属性 `limit` 的设置器，用于更新限制。

properties.name: content
properties.descriptionZh: 模板/内容视图查询引用 `content`（`@ViewChild`），指向内容。

properties.name: positionX
properties.description: The current X position of the notification tip.
properties.descriptionZh: 通知提示的当前 X 轴位置。

properties.name: positionY
properties.description: The current Y position of the notification tip.
properties.descriptionZh: 通知提示的当前 Y 轴位置。

properties.name: hideHost
properties.descriptionZh: 内部使用，当通知提示不显示且无投影内容时隐藏宿主元素。

properties.name: noCount
properties.description:
Sets the component in its 'noCount' state if [notifications] is a boolean 'true'.
Makes the notification tip show without a count.
properties.descriptionZh: 获取当前no计数（`noCount: string | boolean`）。

properties.name: notificationsDisplay
properties.description:
Notification display string when a count is available.
Anything over 99 gets set as 99+

properties.name: show
properties.description: Shows notification tip only when [notifications] is true or a positive integer.

exports.name: NotificationCountPositionX
exports.summary: Enumeration `NotificationCountPositionX` defining supported notification count position x constants.
exports.summaryZh: 枚举 `NotificationCountPositionX`，定义支持的通知计数位置X坐标常量集合。

exports.name: NotificationCountPositionY
exports.summary: Enumeration `NotificationCountPositionY` defining supported notification count position y constants.
exports.summaryZh: 枚举 `NotificationCountPositionY`，定义支持的通知计数位置Y坐标常量集合。

exports.name: NotificationsModule
exports.summary: Angular module `NotificationsModule` declaring and exporting notifications module components, directives, pipes, and providers.
exports.summaryZh: Angular 模块 `NotificationsModule`，声明并导出通知模块相关的组件、指令、管道与服务提供者。
